hooks.command: [ -f package.json ] || exit 0; npm run lint 2>&1 && npm run build 2>&1 && npm run test 2>&1

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'rm[[:space:]]+-[a-z]*(rf|fr)|git[[:space:]]+push.*[[:space:]](--force|-f([[:space:]]|$))|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|drop[[:space:]]+table'; then echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다.' >&2; exit 2; fi
